customPrints.title: Custom Prints
customPrints.subtitle: Share a short idea — we’ll contact you personally.
customPrints.lead: Keep it light for now: a rough idea is enough. We’ll reach out ourselves to discuss details, materials and next steps.

process.label: What to expect
process.title: How commissions work
process.intro: You leave a short note. We contact you. Together we shape the piece — then we print and ship.
process.note: We usually reply within 1–2 business days. No obligation until you approve a quote.

brief.title: Leave a note
brief.body: Share a short idea and how we can reach you (email or WhatsApp). No full brief needed yet.

model.title: We contact you
model.body: We reply personally, ask what’s missing, and advise on material, size and finish.

print.title: Approve & print
print.body: You get a clear quote and model check. After your OK, we print and inspect every piece.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.body: Packed and shipped from Belgium, with tracking when your order leaves the studio.
